description: Lightweight, strongly typed Mongoose alternative where one Zod schema validates data end to end, from client forms to API endpoints to the database, built on the official MongoDB driver
rules: Define a model with mongozod({ collection, db, schema }) from a Zod schema that describes the document as it is stored
Models expose the MongoDB driver's operations (insertOne, findOne, updateOne, replaceOne); Mongoose methods like save, create, findById, lean, exec and populate chains do not exist
Write updates with operators, such as { $set: { title } }, and pass projection, sort and populate as objects in the options of find, never as strings
Filters are not cast: parse an id string with mz.objectId(), or take client filters through mz.filter
Parse each endpoint's input with the schema or the mz builders before it reaches the model, and join owner or tenant conditions with $and
Import the builders with import * as mz from 'mongozod/mzod', and Zod with import * as z from 'zod'
Use mz.objectId(), mz.date() and the other mz field types for BSON values, mz.set() instead of z.set() and z.record() instead of z.map()
Do not put a .transform() on the whole document schema; compute a field from others with .overwrite()
Reads return plain objects without running the schema; save a change with updateOne or replaceOne
Declare indexes in the model's indexes option and create them with sync() on each deploy, or with the autoIndex plugin
